Snacks

Banana mango soft ice

Banán-mangó fagyi

6 months+ Sound idea 120 min 4 portions

Serve a soft spoonful. Mash it again if it starts to freeze hard.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 large Ripe banana (Peeled and chopped)
  • 150 g Ripe mango (Peeled and chopped)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Blend the banana and mango until smooth.
  2. Spread in a shallow tub.
  3. Freeze until just spoonable, about two hours.
  4. Stir once so it does not set into a block.
  5. Mash any firmer edge before serving.

Sound idea

A hard frozen block is difficult for a baby and harsh on teeth. Sugar is not added.

Blend banana and mango and freeze until soft, not solid.
